_comment: Bean `kpcl`, issue #956. EMPTY, and that is the success state: it exempts nothing, so any new contradiction fails. It has held two kinds of entry and shed both. `5a3l` (`completed` over 12 open children) went on 2026-09-22 when the owner re-opened it (#970) and the entry stopped matching — this check FAILED on the stale entry, which is the property working rather than a regression. `10uc` and `z4mq` went on 2026-09-24 when the `open-leaf-complete-checklist` rule became REPORT-ONLY: a bean between its last tick and its close is a normal short-lived state, so that rule prints its finding and sets no exit code, and a non-failing report needs no exemptions. Only the two CONTAINER rules can put an entry here now. THIS FILE MAY ONLY SHRINK: an entry nothing matches is reported stale and fails, so a repair cannot leave a licence behind.
_shape: Same as bean-parents-baseline.json. Key is `<rule>:<bean-id>` — stable across a title edit, because a title is prose and an id is not.
